title: Fixed Open Cradle and Pushrod Caulking Tool
description: One original complete static empty hand caulking-tool appearance. A long thick open-topped U-section cartridge cradle joins a whole front annulus and rear guide plate. A separate fixed pushing disk sits inside near the rear, connected to a long rod and blunt curved rear return. A full canted main grip with flat display heel and a separate squeeze trigger leave a real gap between them; a transverse pivot belongs to the rear housing. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. One prop and zero scenes. Newly authored geometry, not an F-clamp or hair-dryer housing relabelled. No cartridge, nozzle, sealant, ratchet internals, spring, moving action, dispensing instructions, pressure/load, fit, ergonomics or safety claim. Open cradle is partly occupied by the push disk; no wholly empty assembled bore or stable-use certification is claimed.
